description: Holds storyboard stills for a duration each and lays a soundtrack under them. The result is one clip. It is a cheap check on pacing and order before any video model is paid for. 'boards' is a list of images - asset: references uploaded with upload_asset or promoted with keep_output, or the stills of an earlier run - all the same size; a still that resolves to several images contributes each of them in order. 'durations' is seconds per board: one number holds every board for that long, or a list gives one number per board. Each board gets max(1, round(duration * fps)) frames, and the clip is at most 600 seconds and 36000 frames. 'soundtrack' is one audio asset, such as the text-to-speech scratch track or a music bed, and the output's audio is that track trimmed or padded with silence to the clip's length (pair_audio with its fit set to the picture, which warns either way), so a track longer than the boards is cut off and a shorter one leaves the tail silent. A track meant to line up with the boards must be cut to the same durations beforehand; the template does not time boards to the audio. The clip's shot records mark where each board starts.
